description: Repo-scale (makefile-buildsystem): a new src/info/ module must both be correctly wired into the build (SRCS + include path) AND print the SAME version as the VERSION file, not a hardcoded string of its own
prompts: Add a plain-text `VERSION` file at the repo root containing `2.0.0`. In the Makefile, read it once via `APP_VERSION := $(shell cat VERSION)` and embed it into the build via `-DAPP_VERSION=\"$(APP_VERSION)\"` in CFLAGS. Add a new module `src/info/` (info.h/info.c) with `void info_build_string(char *buf, size_t bufsize)`, which formats `"build <version>"` into `buf` via snprintf using the `APP_VERSION` macro (with a standalone-compile fallback `#ifndef APP_VERSION #define APP_VERSION "unknown" #endif`) - it must NOT hardcode its own version string, since that would silently drift from VERSION the next time it's bumped. Wire the new module into src/cli/main.c (call it and print the result) and into the Makefile: add its sources to `SRCS` (a brand new directory needs its own `$(wildcard ...)` line) AND add `-Isrc/info` to CFLAGS so `main.c`'s `#include "info.h"` can resolve - both the sources and the include path are needed, and forgetting either one breaks the build.

test_setup_files.check_info_version.py:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

r = subprocess.run(['make', 'clean'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
assert r.returncode == 0, f'make clean failed:\n{r.stdout}\n{r.stderr}'

r = subprocess.run(['make', 'all'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
assert r.returncode == 0, f'make all failed (is src/info wired into SRCS and -Isrc/info?):\n{r.stdout}\n{r.stderr}'

run = subprocess.run(['./bin/app'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
assert run.returncode == 0, f'./bin/app failed:\n{run.stdout}\n{run.stderr}'

version = Path('VERSION').read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip()
expected = f'build {version}'
assert expected in run.stdout, (
    f'expected ./bin/app output to contain {expected!r} (matching the VERSION file), got: '
    f'{run.stdout!r} - info_build_string must read the SAME APP_VERSION the Makefile embeds from '
    f'VERSION, not a hardcoded string of its own that can drift out of sync')

print('PASS')

reference_solution.Makefile:
CC := gcc
APP_VERSION := $(shell cat VERSION)
CFLAGS := -std=c11 -Wall -MMD -MP -Isrc/core -Isrc/utils -Isrc/info -DAPP_VERSION=\"$(APP_VERSION)\"

CORE_SRCS := $(wildcard src/core/*.c)
UTILS_SRCS := $(wildcard src/utils/*.c)
INFO_SRCS := $(wildcard src/info/*.c)
CLI_SRCS := $(wildcard src/cli/*.c)
SRCS := $(CORE_SRCS) $(UTILS_SRCS) $(INFO_SRCS) $(CLI_SRCS)
OBJS := $(SRCS:.c=.o)
DEPS := $(OBJS:.o=.d)

BINDIR := bin
TARGET := $(BINDIR)/app

TEST_SRCS := $(CORE_SRCS) $(UTILS_SRCS) tests/test_calc.c
TEST_TARGET := $(BINDIR)/test_calc

.PHONY: all clean test

all: $(TARGET)

$(TARGET): $(OBJS) | $(BINDIR)
	$(CC) $(OBJS) -o $(TARGET)

%.o: %.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

$(BINDIR):
	mkdir -p $(BINDIR)

test: $(TEST_TARGET)
	./$(TEST_TARGET)

$(TEST_TARGET): $(TEST_SRCS) | $(BINDIR)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(TEST_SRCS) -o $(TEST_TARGET)

clean:
	rm -rf $(BINDIR) $(DEPS) $(OBJS)

-include $(DEPS)
